title: Cap. IX Arg. 14 Sol cont.: second knot — Biel: do not posit priorities (or plural ordered acts) among these divine decrees; ranking incarnation before/after election is false speculation
pass_a_gloss: Secondly this knot can be cut, if anyone with Biel defend that those Priorities are not to be placed in these Divine decrees, as neither pluralities of ordered acts; and accordingly if anyone should wish to consider such an order of these decrees as places the incarnation of Christ prior to election, or on the contrary, that this consideration is false speculation. So Biel, in 3. dist. 2. qu. dub. 3.
pass_b_english: Second, this knot can be cut with Biel: those priorities are not to be set among these divine decrees — nor pluralities of ordered acts. So if anyone wants to consider an order of these decrees that sets Christ's incarnation before election, or the reverse, that consideration is false speculation (Biel, in 3. dist. 2. qu. dub. 3).
source_text: Secundo nodus iste discindi potest, si quis cum Biele defendat, Prioritates illas in Divinis hisce decretis non esse ponendas, sicut nec pluralitates actuum ordinatorum; ac proinde si quis considerare velit talem ordinem horum decretorum ut ponat Christi incarnationem electione priorem, vel e contra, hanc considerationem esse falsam speculationem. Sic Biel, in 3. dist. 2. qu. dub. 3.
